title: Valid Tic-Tac-Toe Board State
description:
Given a `3 x 3` Tic-Tac-Toe board represented as a string array `board` of length `3`, where each string has length `3` and contains only `'X'`, `'O'`, or space `' '`, return `true` if and only if it is possible to reach this board state during the course of a valid Tic-Tac-Toe game.

The rules of Tic-Tac-Toe are:
1. Players take turns placing marks into empty squares (`' '`), with `'X'` always playing first.
2. The game ends immediately as soon as any row, column, or main/anti-diagonal contains three identical non-empty marks (or all 9 squares are filled).
3. No more moves can be made after the game ends.
hints: Because 'X' always moves first and players alternate, count(X) must equal count(O) or count(O) + 1.

Check whether 'X' has a winning line and whether 'O' has a winning line: both cannot win simultaneously, if 'X' wins then count(X) must equal count(O) + 1, and if 'O' wins then count(X) must equal count(O).

examples.explanation: 'O' cannot play before 'X' makes the first move, so count(X) = 0 and count(O) = 1 is invalid.
